item.title: When Accountability Wears a Fucking Mask
item.description: A government that insists every civilian must instantly obey armed, masked agents has a fucking monumental obligation to ensure those agents are disciplined, accountable, and restrained. Instead, too often the response is secrecy, spin, and "trust us." ⚖️ The most dangerous phrase in any democracy isn't "national security." It's "don't ask questions." When transparency disappears behind redactions and official statements become public relations exercises, public trust dies right alongside it. Power without accountability isn't law enforcement- it's permission. And when institutions circle the wagons instead of confronting uncomfortable facts, every future tragedy becomes easier to dismiss than prevent. That's how democracies slowly rot from the inside. Nobody should have to wonder whether the full truth will ever see daylight after a government use of deadly force. Independent investigations, transparency, and accountability aren't anti-police- they're pro-democracy. Demand better. #Accountability #Transparency #CivilRights #Democracy #Justice #RuleOfLaw
